description: Project how your savings grow over time with compound interest, regular monthly contributions and your choice of compounding frequency.

faqs.a: The annual rate is treated as a nominal rate compounding at the selected frequency (monthly, quarterly or annually), and monthly contributions are added every month using the equivalent monthly rate.
